no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was required or convened for this NDA. There are multiple drug products in this drug class, prostaglandin analogues marketed in the United States.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the VYZULTA (NDA207795) application. The FDA review documents (Summary Review and Medical Review) state that there were no efficacy or safety issues that would benefit from an Advisory Committee discussion, noting the product is a member of the prostaglandin analog class with multiple similar products already marketed in the U.S. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
